title: Displayed power weights stats unevenly
body: Attack-type cookies (magic, ranged, burst) carry high power; healers, tanks and supports low, so lineup swaps move team power without new resources. Gear power is dynamic: a stat below the lineup's target counts heavily and stops counting once met (an item's power fell 69.6M → 65M after a resistance target was reached); accuracy past about 1,000 adds little; crit resistance is the strongest padding line.

title: Flat versus percentage stats
body: Resolve adds flat ATK/DEF/HP to every cookie (+2/+2/+20 per level after 101); gear lines are multiplied by percentage bonuses, so late in the game a gear line outweighs hundreds of Resolve levels (+87 ATK on a bow raised Milk's ATK 6k, +200 Resolve ~1k).

title: How Stellar Link scales
body: A constellation's bonus follows the polygon area through its points in order; points open with the account's total cookie stars; later constellations give more amplification at the same area. Up to 6 points can be locked; a roll costs 10 Stellar Points unlocked, 220 with 6 locked.

title: Plating results and the 1.4.002 change
body: Each attempt is a great success (+2), success (+1), maintain, decline (from 10) or shatter (from 15). Syrup Metal protects against declines (1–3 per attempt) and halves shatters (2). From 2026-09-23 a shatter drops 2 levels instead of to 10 and can be restored with Syrup (20 at 15 to 80 at 24); the cap is 25 and every step from 19 is 2%.

title: Oven level sets gear level
body: Gear level runs from oven level × 3 − 5 to oven level × 3; higher rarities enter the draw table with oven level (Eternal from 31 at 0.002% per draw). A lower-rarity piece of higher level can show more power.

title: Chests and dungeons scale with progress
body: Coin and EXP auto-hunt chests pay by the current stage, so they are worth more opened later; daily dungeon keys pay by floor (64 per key low, 4,000–6,000 high), so extra entries (Crumble Pass, the 5.5 membership, key packs) compound.

title: Sweet Blessing is a spending track
body: Purchases fill the Sweet Blessing level (about 10% of spend as points; level 3 under ~100,000 KRW; 12 levels); it adds perks such as daily dungeon entries and a Wind Archer copy at level 3, not stats.
